headline: Nairobi Securities Exchange Extends Daily Trading Hours to Boost Liquidity
summary: The Nairobi Securities Exchange received regulatory approval to extend daily trading hours by one hour starting in January 2027, aiming to deepen trading liquidity and attract global investors.
why: The NSE is East Africa's primary capital market hub, seeking to increase foreign investor participation and trading volumes.

impacts.name: NSE 20 Share Index
impacts.why: Extended operating hours are aimed at improving turnover and market liquidity for Kenyan equities.
